status: Native major Vanishing Point workflow implemented and tested. Full F05/Photoshop parity remains open.
scope: Saved perspective planes and connected planes, perspective paste/clone/brush, native preview workspace, local/document Undo, native32 persistence and shared Photato API.

primary_references.scope: Perspective workspace and tool families. Secondary marquee, measurement and healing remain open.
Four-corner planes, related planes and angles, retained document planes.
Brush/clone controls and source alignment. Multi-surface wrapping and healing are not implemented.

primary_references.finding: No dedicated Vanishing Point operation. Unqualified actionJSON remains explicitly unsupported.

implementation_choices: Swift camera inference, projective plane mapping and related-plane Rodrigues rotation reuse the original Rust approach; brush painting extends the upstream paste/clone commands.

Sequential draft operations composite over the original visible sample; a clone stroke freezes its source. Source-layer paste uses raw raster pixels, matching the API; clipboard import performs color conversion.
Renderer Float32 samples convert to the document depth at the prepared-edit boundary. Selection, affine target placement and image/transparency locks apply, with optional new-layer output.
Saved canonical focal/center/root planes follow global canvas/path transforms. Related planes retain their links. Nonuniform camera recalibration remains unqualified.
Prepared edits are cancellable and reject stale source documents before commit. One command retains plane metadata and pixels together; local workspace undo is separate from document history.

photato_api.state: Strict settings/operation schemas; document and workspace saved settings plus resolved plane corners/metric dimensions; active tool, selection, preview/rendering, navigation and local history availability. Existing revision/busy/sharing protections apply.

adobe_api.scope: No invented Adobe route. Unqualified Vanishing Point actionJSON and editable PSD/PSB plane metadata reject. Rendered raster export remains available.

tests.independent_evidence: Analytical 3D camera/focal/aspect/perpendicular shared-edge checks, all-depth paste/clone/brush and clipping, selections/locks/transforms/history/cancellation/invalid atomicity/native32, native controllers and API equality/busy/stale/schema guards. Not independent Photoshop pixels.
tests.offscreen_limit: Inspected pixels, perspective brush/grid and native control arrangement. AppKit button/picker capture incomplete offscreen; no live visual/pointer qualification.

limitations: Perspective marquee/floating selections/cut, measurement, healing modes and multi-surface stroke wrapping are absent. Full F05 remains open.
No recorded Actions integration for this prepared composite operation; playback/recording reports unsupported rather than silently omitting it. Direct desktop and API are implemented.
Target must be an ordinary raster layer. Native workspace admission currently needs an unlocked image target even when new-layer output would be possible in the engine/API.

32 planes,256 operations,16,384 supplied points,4,096 per stroke,128MiB embedded sources,8,388,608 canvas/target pixels and134,217,728 raster visits. Larger document performance remains open; API sharing limits apply separately.
Exact Adobe pixels, full color-mode matrix, complete grid/keyboard/context interactions and nonuniform transformed-camera recalibration are unqualified.
Native32 preserves planes. Adobe PSD/PSB plane metadata and .vpe interchange are unsupported; explicit save guards prevent silent metadata loss.
Latest desktop evidence remains locked. No re-probe/bypass. Live UI, physical Intel and macOS14/26 validation remain open; current-host tests and universal builds do not prove these gates.
next: B01 major painting workflow: native Brush Settings, custom tips/dynamics and reusable presets with canvas/API/history integration. Defer exact kernels and cosmetic refinement.
